deployment.title: Self-Service BI Development (Metabase)
deployment.subtitle: Democratizing Data for Agile Growth
deployment.intro: Stop running your business on gut feelings and broken spreadsheets. We deploy Metabase, a powerful BI engine that turns your scattered data into a clear, centralized command center—scalable from day one.

steps.extraction: 1. Extraction (The Gathering): We use custom scripts and APIs to pull data from your CRM, Ads, ERP, and databases.
steps.warehousing: 2. Warehousing (The Storage): We centralize this data into a high-performance database (PostgreSQL/BigQuery) optimized for analytics.
steps.modeling: 3. Modeling (The Logic): We clean and structure the data using SQL, so 'Revenue' actually means 'Revenue'.
steps.visualization: 4. Visualization (The Interface): We deploy Metabase on top, giving you beautiful, drag-and-drop dashboards.

selfHosted.title: Self-Hosted
selfHosted.description: Total Ownership. You own your data. No per-user licensing fees that punish you for growing.

headless.description: My data is trapped in software that doesn't have a database connection? We write custom Python/Node.js scripts to hit the APIs of your niche software, normalize that JSON data, and store it in a warehouse. Result: You get analytics for software that doesn't even have analytics features.

feature3.description: We create continuous integration and deployment pipelines that meet all current industry standards.

feature4.description: We provide consulting for any type of software project or digital transformation in the company.

wordpress.dev: Beyond its blogging roots, WordPress is a powerful CMS for enterprise applications. We leverage its flexibility to build scalable, secure, and highly customized solutions, including headless CMS architectures for multi-platform content delivery.
wordpress.devops: We implement robust, Git-based CI/CD pipelines for WordPress, enabling automated testing and seamless deployments. Our multi-environment setups (dev, staging, prod) and performance monitoring ensure stability and reliability for high-traffic sites.

dotnet.dev: .NET is our choice for high-performance, cross-platform enterprise applications. We build scalable microservices and cloud-native solutions with a focus on security and robustness.
dotnet.devops: We leverage Azure DevOps to create comprehensive CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications. Our expertise in containerization with Docker and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform ensures automated, consistent, and efficient deployments.

java.dev: Java's robust ecosystem and platform independence make it ideal for large-scale enterprise systems. We specialize in building microservices and cloud-native applications using modern frameworks like Spring Boot, ensuring scalability and efficiency.
java.devops: We implement a comprehensive DevOps strategy for Java applications, including automated testing, continuous integration with Jenkins or GitHub Actions, and containerized deployments with Docker and Kubernetes. We also integrate security practices (DevSecOps) throughout the pipeline.

python.dev: Python's versatility allows us to build scalable web applications and powerful backend services with frameworks like Django and Flask. We also leverage Python for data processing and API development.
python.devops: Python is our go-to for DevOps automation. We write scripts to automate testing, deployments, and infrastructure provisioning (using tools like Ansible). We also build custom monitoring dashboards and integrate with CI/CD pipelines to streamline the entire development lifecycle.

flutter.dev: Flutter enables us to build beautiful, high-performance, and cross-platform mobile applications from a single codebase. We focus on creating a seamless user experience for both iOS and Android.
flutter.devops: We implement robust CI/CD pipelines for Flutter to automate the build, test, and deployment process for both platforms. This includes unit, widget, and integration testing, as well as automated deployments to app stores and testing environments.

vue.dev: Vue.js's component-based architecture and flexibility make it an excellent choice for modern web applications. We build reactive, performant, and maintainable user interfaces, leveraging strategies like Static Site Generation (SSG) and Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
vue.devops: We create efficient CI/CD pipelines for Vue.js applications using tools like GitHub Actions. Our deployment strategies include containerization with Docker and hosting on scalable cloud services like AWS and Vercel, ensuring high availability and performance.

react.dev: React is our framework of choice for building complex, component-driven user interfaces. We follow best practices for project structure, state management, and testing to create scalable and maintainable applications.
react.devops: We implement comprehensive CI/CD pipelines for React applications, with automated unit and end-to-end testing. We utilize branch protection, staging environments, and monitoring to ensure reliable and high-quality releases.
